text: Can you describe the onset of your right knee swelling and any specific movements that trigger or alleviate the pain? Additionally, have you noticed any redness, warmth, or locking sensations in the joint?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia B (Christmas Disease).

Based on the patient's age, spontaneous swelling in the right knee without trauma, and the family history of similar issues on the maternal side, this presentation is highly suggestive of a hereditary bleeding disorder. I need to confirm the specific factor deficiency and rule out other causes.

REQUEST TEST: Coagulation Profile (PT, aPTT, Factor IX Activity)
